limits: Seeded diagnostic, not population win rates or proof of complete tactical equality.
Some442 press/counter advantages and low-block weaknesses remain; include every condition.
Actual tackle contact counts remain above professional football distributions.
Strong fifth-tier starter squad and top-tier investment/difficulty need human-play feedback.
excludedCandidateGroups: Deep compact/goal-side geometry and unconditional press braking could worsen other formations.
Unconditional jockeying slowed pursuing defenders; goal-side-only jockeying still had formation-dependent bias.
Uniform tackle effort hurt planted low-block defence; final effort follows actual speed.
Shared early transition runs for every style worsened80/433 candidate results and were not adopted.
